messages:
Maya: ACME SI just proposed a blended private offer visible in Marketplace: 12-month commit + hardware rebate + co-marketing pool. Need quick alignment on mechanics and renewal protections.

AJ (sales): Clarify whether they want prepaid commit or monthly invoiced committed spend. Marketplace private offers usually map to prepaid SKUs but we can do monthly true-up.

ACME_SI: Marketplace private offer with prepaid commit is preferred. We want the co-marketing funds escrowed and released on milestone sign-offs: alpha demo, joint case study, public announce. Hardware rebate should be invoiced post-delivery.

Devon (product): Product-side: we'll need a private SKU with tiered pricing. Questions: carryover of unused commit? fallback model variants if peak usage exceeds capacity?

Lina (finance): Prefer prepaid with monthly consumption true-up and no carryover. Escrowed marketing funds must be treated as a restricted liability until released. We'll model cash flow impact.

Nate (legal): We'll draft clawback + milestone acceptance language. Define consumption := Redwood-billed usage (tokens + embeddings). Also recommend firm definitions for "public announce" and opt-out review windows for case studies.

Maya: Sketch of proposed terms: 
- Term: 12 months, Prepaid commit: $1,200,000 (applied as private SKU credit)
- Measurement: Redwood billed units (tokens + embeddings) aggregated monthly
- Utilization tiers for renewal credit: 
  * utilization <70% -> no renewal rebate, standard committed pricing applies
  * 70%-89% -> 25% rebate applied as account credit at renewal
  * >=90% -> 50% rebate applied as prepaid credit on renewal
- Co-marketing: $250k placed in escrow (tracked off-marketplace); released in 3 equal tranches upon signed milestone docs (demo, case study approval, public announce)
- Hardware rebate: $200k one-time payable after month 6 contingent on >=60% utilization
- Low-utilization fallback: if term-end utilization <60% then pricing reverts to list minus 10% floor for immediate replacement SKUs
- Marketplace mechanics: private SKU with partner-facing listing; external accrual tracked for co-marketing funds

AJ (sales): Tranches and milestone docs look fine. Ops needs to confirm marketplace can represent private SKU discount and we can map an "external-credit" in our billing to track the co-marketing escrow. ping ops-bot.

ops-bot: Marketplace supports private SKUs and SKU-level discounts. No native escrow; recommend external accrual + manual payout triggers based on milestone PDFs. Billing can ingest an "external-credit" identifier for reconciliation.

ACME_SI: Case study release should require partner approval before publication; 45-day review window acceptable. For announce milestone, we require cadence alignment with our PR team.

Nate (legal): Add opt-in approvals and a 45-day review window post-draft. Clawback: pro-rata return of remaining co-marketing funds if partner terminates or breaches, with 30-day cure period.

Devon (product): I'll prepare SKU naming, listing plan, and a fallback/auto-quantization option to route heavy traffic to cheaper compatible model variants if capacity pressure appears.

Lina (finance): I'll run recognition and reserve impact and confirm how the prepaid $1.2M shows up (deferred revenue) and how the $250k escrow is handled on books. Expect model by Monday.

Maya: Action items recap: 
- AJ: draft Marketplace private offer entry in Partner Portal + internal term-sheet by Wed EOD
- Nate: 1-pg legal clauses (clawback, approvals, definitions) by Fri
- Devon: SKU + listing + capacity fallback plan by next Tue
- Lina: finance model + recognition guidance by Mon
- ACME_SI: confirm case study approval and milestone cadence by Thu

AJ (sales): Ack, will produce the partner portal draft.

ACME_SI: Ack, we will get internal approvals and loop back on milestones.

Maya: If no objections I'll convert this into a short term-sheet to circulate to ACME this week.
